title: Detailed banana
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='body' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFE94A'/>
      <stop offset='55%' stop-color='#FFD31A'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#E8A200'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='shade' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#D98C00'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#B36A00'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='tip' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#7A5A2E'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#4A3416'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- main curved body -->
  <path d='M30 16
           C 20 20, 16 32, 18 44
           C 20 58, 28 70, 40 80
           C 50 88, 62 92, 72 88
           C 80 85, 84 78, 80 72
           C 76 66, 66 64, 56 62
           C 44 60, 34 54, 32 44
           C 30 34, 34 24, 40 18
           C 37 15, 33 14, 30 16 Z'
        fill='url(#body)'/>

  <!-- inner shadow along the concave side -->
  <path d='M40 18
           C 34 24, 30 34, 32 44
           C 34 54, 44 60, 56 62
           C 66 64, 76 66, 80 72
           C 81 74, 81 76, 80 78
           C 74 74, 66 72, 56 70
           C 42 67, 30 60, 26 48
           C 23 38, 26 26, 33 19
           C 35 17, 38 17, 40 18 Z'
        fill='url(#shade)' opacity='0.55'/>

  <!-- ridge highlight -->
  <path d='M32 22
           C 25 30, 23 40, 26 50
           C 29 60, 38 68, 50 74'
        fill='none' stroke='#FFFBAA' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.85'/>

  <!-- second highlight lower -->
  <path d='M52 78 C 58 82, 66 84, 73 82'
        fill='none' stroke='#FFF6A0' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.7'/>

  <!-- stem at top -->
  <path d='M30 16 C 29 12, 30 8, 33 6 C 36 5, 39 7, 40 10 C 41 13, 40 16, 40 18 Z'
        fill='url(#tip)'/>
  <path d='M32.5 12 C 33 9, 35 7.5, 37 8'
        fill='none' stroke='#9C7A48' stroke-width='1.4' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- bruised tip at bottom -->
  <path d='M72 88 C 79 86, 84 79, 80 72 C 79 70, 77 69, 75 69
           C 77 74, 75 81, 69 85 C 70 87, 71 88, 72 88 Z'
        fill='url(#tip)' opacity='0.9'/>

  <!-- subtle spot marks -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='40' rx='2' ry='2.6' fill='#C98A0A' opacity='0.5'/>
  <ellipse cx='46' cy='58' rx='2.2' ry='2.8' fill='#C98A0A' opacity='0.45'/>
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='72' rx='1.8' ry='2.4' fill='#B87A06' opacity='0.4'/>
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='78' rx='1.6' ry='2' fill='#B87A06' opacity='0.35'/>
</svg>
